scheme_name: National Renewable Energy Fellowship Scheme of the Human Resource Development Programme in New and Renewable Energy
other_conditions: Applicants must be pursuing higher studies in renewable energy (M.Sc, M.Tech, PhD) or be a Research Associate/post‑doctoral fellow
Fellowships are only for courses on renewable energy subjects
Selection for M.Tech/PhD programmes must be through GATE, CSIR, CSIR‑JRF, AICTE or NET qualified scores
M.Sc fellowships are limited to students pursuing an M.Sc in renewable energy who have qualified NET
Eligibility for JRF/SRF/RA/PDF follows CSIR/DST/UGC norms
Eligibility for M.Tech follows AICTE guidelines and for M.Sc follows Department of Biotechnology norms
Institutes must be within the Top 100 of the NIRF rankings and have the required faculty and infrastructure for renewable energy education and research
benefits_summary: Monthly fellowship stipends ranging from ₹4,000 to ₹54,000 depending on the programme, with HRA and contingency benefits where applicable.
